name: A Sealed Crate

aliases: what is inside the sealed crate
faq.answer: The crate holds commercial cargo, though its exact contents are not given. Merchants and handlers want the goods secured away from thieves.
faq.q: What is inside the sealed crate?

faq.answer: Bandits and thieves have struck trade routes, scattering shipments and leaving crates abandoned or stolen across the region.
faq.q: Why are these crates lying around?

faq.answer: Local merchants and trade coordinators receive the recovered crates. They add the goods to secure stores and pay adventurers who salvage them from danger.
Yes. Bandits continue to disrupt overland travel, so local handlers pay adventurers to recover other crates scattered along trade routes.
faq.q: Can more sealed crates be recovered?

faq.answer: Bandits and outlaws prey on unguarded caravans, threatening trade routes. Merchants pay for cargo recovered from the roads.
faq.q: What is threatening the trade routes?

faq.answer: The reason for the seal is not given. You return the lost cargo to the handlers, who add it to their pile and pay you.

sections.body: Bandits and thieves have struck established trade routes, leaving merchant cargo scattered. Their ambushes put caravans and supply lines at risk. Across contested lands, lost shipments are a common sight. Recovering the crates helps local trade endure the lawlessness.
sections.title: Disrupted Trade Routes

sections.body: Merchants and handlers rely on couriers to bring lost goods back to storage depots. Each returned crate adds to local stores and denies outlaws the gains of highway robbery. In return, salvage workers receive fair pay for facing dangerous roads.
sections.title: Recovered Cargo

summary: Trade recipients seek A Sealed Crate after bandits disrupt the roads. Recovered cargo helps keep local stores supplied and out of outlaw hands.
attribution: In-game quest text: A Sealed Crate
